artifacts.summary: 14-phase, 14-hour plan covering the repo-side half of the 28-item paper/Lean/docs discrepancy inventory, with the read-only paper's items routed to an author memo.

memory_candidates.content: When planning a wide documentation/docstring alignment sweep driven by a discrepancy inventory (D1..Dn), cut phases by FILE TERRITORY, not by discrepancy ID. Discrepancy IDs cross-cut files (one .lean file often carries three unrelated IDs), so ID-grouped phases collide on the same file and cannot be parallelized. Territory-grouped phases have disjoint file sets and run in one wave. Two corollaries: (1) any sweep whose file set is only estimated ("~20 other quote sites") must be its own phase scheduled AFTER every file-scoped phase, so it can touch any file without conflict, and its first task is producing the concrete grep-derived list; (2) a single file with concurrent uncommitted working-tree changes must have exactly one designated entry-point phase that owns the reconciliation, with all other phases touching it sequenced behind that one.
